turns.speaker: host
turns.text: El Momento BCS reports that extortion investigations in Baja California Sur reached 143 cases from January to September this year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is up from 99 the year before, according to the national public security secretariat.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same report notes 127 of those cases arrived by phone or remote contact.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Wait— that leaves 16 in person. Authorities urge people not to answer suspicious calls.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They are also coordinating with Los Cabos hotels on tourist safety.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: At the same time El Economista reports the state expects more than 332 million pesos in tourism spending.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The spending covers the long weekend and the Baja 1000 race [chuckle].

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Hotel occupancy is projected near 80 percent across the main destinations.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The race begins 13 November in San José del Cabo, its first start in the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: This is Radio BCS2050. Our topic today is Tourism.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The question we will answer is how the rise in extortion cases is intersecting with the strong visitor numbers the state is counting on.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: El Economista reports that Baja California Sur expects over 332 million pesos in spending during the long weekend tied to the Baja 1000.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That lines up with their forecast of about 120,000 hotel guests.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: From November 13 to 16. What does that volume mean for the smaller towns?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Hotel occupancy should hit 78 percent in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 75 percent in La Paz and full in Comondú.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The state tourism ministry also projects 76 to 85 percent in Loreto and 85 to 90 percent in Mulegé.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The SCORE Baja 1000 starts for the first time in San José del Cabo.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How might the new starting point shift spending away from the usual spots?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meganoticias says Condor resumed direct Frankfurt to Los Cabos flights on November 2.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: With a 92 percent load factor.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Germany already accounts for more than 60 percent of those passengers.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The route runs Mondays and Fridays through March 2027 on an A330-900neo.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Bookings are up 37.5 percent from last season. It remains the only nonstop from Europe to Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The prior season saw load factor rise from 45.7 percent to 74.4 percent. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Revista Espejo covered the Mar de Cortés Forum where IMCO noted BCS climbed in state competitiveness.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: From 8th to 5th between 2021 and 2026.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Valeria Moy from IMCO said the region needs to change how it makes decisions.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: She sees opportunity in stronger North American ties and higher value-added activities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That rise stands out because neighboring states like Sinaloa and Sonora slipped in the same ranking.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Now the tension: El Momento BCS reports extortion investigations in BCS jumped 44.4 percent.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: In the first nine months of 2026.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The national secretariat recorded 143 cases.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Compared with 99 in the same period of 2025.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Of those, 127 came through phone or remote means and 16 happened in person.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Authorities are urging residents and visitors not to answer suspicious calls.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They also highlight ongoing coordination with Los Cabos hotels to protect tourist safety.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How might that 44 percent rise affect the 120,000 guests expected this weekend?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The state tourism ministry is betting the events and the new flights will still bring strong numbers.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yet the competitiveness gains could be tested if remote extortion keeps growing.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly. The open question is whether the coordination with hotels can keep the impact on visitors low. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: El Economista reported on November 10 that the state tourism and economy ministry expects about 120,000 hotel guests in Baja California Sur from 13 to 16 November.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Really? That many people in just four days.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That lines up with the long weekend and the Baja 1000 race.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They forecast more than 332 million pesos in spending.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And roughly 80 percent average hotel occupancy across the state.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos sits at 78 percent.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz reaches 75 percent.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto falls between 76 and 85 percent.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú hits 100 percent.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: [chuckle] Every room taken there.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mulegé sits at 85 to 90 percent.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The SCORE Baja 1000 starts for the first time in San José del Cabo on the 13th.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz is described in the state planning data as the capital of services, knowledge, administration and logistics.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It also has the lowest municipal poverty rate and serves as the hinge between the inland areas and the cape.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Loreto is positioned as the mid-peninsula tourism and conservation node with a strong natural brand.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It functions as a quieter alternative to Los Cabos and an anchor along the mid-corridor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Water and seasonal loads still set limits on how much it can grow.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: El Momento BCS reported on November 17 that extortion investigations in the state rose 44.4 percent in the first nine months of 2026.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The national secretariat recorded 143 cases.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That compares with 99 the year before.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Most were phone or remote cases, and authorities are coordinating with Los Cabos hotels on tourist safety.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They are also urging people not to answer suspicious calls.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Several large properties in Los Cabos appear on the tourism inventory, including Marquis Los Cabos and Secrets Puerto Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The hotels listed carry names such as Hacienda Beach Club, Westin Los Cabos, and Buenavista Oceanfront.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One of them, Secrets Puerto Los Cabos, is also named in a CONALEP dual-model hotel list.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The practical effect is that seasonal spikes land unevenly across the municipalities.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz and Loreto carry different infrastructure loads than the corridor resorts.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The coordination on safety is one visible link between the numbers and daily operations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It shows how tourism touches planning and security in each place.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The latest reports show Hotel San Cristóbal in Punta Lobos suspended operations after wave damage to its beachfront rooms.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Meganoticias noted the hotel will assess the structure before any reopening, with no date set yet.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Nigua added that Profepa inspected the site on 11 November and found no wastewater or chemical releases to the sea.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the same inspection will now review the environmental permit and waste handling for the damaged sections.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fishers from Punta Lobos have raised the same beach-dynamics concern since 2015, HOY BCS reports.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That thread runs straight into the portal's earlier Foresight notes on coastal resilience.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal already flagged that extreme tides from Vance and El Niño now join water scarcity as hard limits on tourism growth.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Meanwhile Los Cabos air connections grew 61 percent in ten years, El Financiero states, with five new Canadian routes added.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fiturca expects roughly 300,000 Canadian visitors this year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That is a big jump from recent numbers.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Baja Ferries carries over 200,000 passengers annually on the La Paz routes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Its CEO Nino Liaño wants to reach 300 to 400,000 with cruise-style packages.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: He also pointed out that 90 percent of all goods reaching BCS still arrive by sea.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state government estimates the Baja 1000 left about 800 million pesos in local spending last week.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Hotel occupancy in Los Cabos hit 78 percent in early November, four points above last year.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Here is the surprise turn: the same 2026 revenue laws show Los Cabos collected 7421559352 pesos while last in water-investment rankings.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal's September edition already called that mismatch the leading brake on new tourism FDI.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So connectivity keeps rising while the basic grid and desal capacity stay flat.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The 2020 census counted 351,111 residents in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That is already a large base and still growing.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz had 292,241 residents in the same count.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Housing registrations for 2025 sat at 776 statewide, well below earlier years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That gap leaves the coastal infrastructure exposed exactly where the next high tide or storm lands.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The question is whether the environmental review now under way at Punta Lobos will force a wider look at those limits. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Or whether the push for more visitors will simply outrun the water and shoreline capacity already on record.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Did you know Los Cabos hotels reached 78 percent occupancy from November 1 to 15 this year?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That stands out right away.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: SETUE reported 70.0 percent for the full year of 2025.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Asociación de Hoteles de Los Cabos shared the newer figure through Tribuna de México.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What does 78 percent look like in practice? [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: There are 188 hotels in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They hold 22,254 rooms in total.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: At 78 percent, how many stay full each night?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Roughly that many rooms.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: La Paz runs at a different scale.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It has 148 hotels.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: With only 3,841 rooms altogether.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Occupancy there reached 64 percent in 2025.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Average stays are shorter too.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Just 2.04 days in La Paz.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos visitors stay 4.7 days on average.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That difference changes how the same spending lands in each place.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos must handle daily water and waste loads from nearly full hotels.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The POEL consultation now requires new desal and wastewater plants for added rooms.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Developers must show those systems before permits advance.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same plan asks for density limits along the Cabo del Este road.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Public consultation on the El Tezal partial plan will help decide the next steps.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those rules aim to match growth with real infrastructure instead of promises.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet sales have dropped sharply in recent years.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Senator Susana Zatarain noted a 25 to 35 percent decline over two years.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: At least 27 restaurants closed or paused operations.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents in Cabo San Lucas marched over water shortages during that same period.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The core tension sits between tourism investment and the lack of new water sources.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's foresight flags exactly that brake on further growth in Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Polo and Rachel brought flooding and port closures that hit tourism directly.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Hydro-meteorological risks now shape planning across the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The question becomes how the new POEL rules will keep infrastructure ahead of the next high season.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The baseline scenario in the BCS 2050 database shows tourism and coastal growth continuing in Los Cabos, East Cape and Loreto, with existing DMA deficits already recorded for those poles.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal flags hotel pressure and protected area interfaces as part of that same baseline.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The ontology asks whether a project stays viable once water from DMA or aquifers, energy from SIBCS and CFE, and land instruments such as POERBCS and PDU are all coupled together.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That viability package lists the five municipalities already coded for comparison.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos carries the 2026 revenue law figure of 7421559352 pesos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How does that compare with the next largest municipality?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz lists 2905974532 pesos under the same 2026 revenue law.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The state expenditure budget approved for 2026 stands at 26903040145 pesos.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The 2020 INEGI census gives Los Cabos a municipal population of 351111.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same census records La Paz at 292241.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Housing registrations from SNIIV and SEDATU show 1079 actions in 2023.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What happened the following year?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The figure stood at 990 actions in 2024 across the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: By 2025 the figure had dropped to 776.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos accounted for 142 of those 2025 registrations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The 2012 book by Enrico Moretti documents how tourism can generate innovation-sector multipliers when paired with diversification.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The 2015 COLMEX and UABJO study records tourism-driven land conversion in Mexican coastal destinations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The 2008 UNEP MAP Barcelona Convention protocol remains the only binding international instrument on integrated coastal zone management.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Imagen Radio reported on 27 October 2026 that hotel occupancy fell 5 percent in the second half of the year. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Another report from the same outlet noted a 14 percent drop in US tourists from January to August.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México placed October occupancy at 60 percent.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The ontology flags restrictions from ANP, coastline rules, land tenure and seawater intrusion that must be checked before any new hotel or desalinator proceeds.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One concrete object that surfaces all of these layers is the water meter installed at a new coastal hotel. [pause]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That single meter connects the daily room count to the DMA balance, the CFE power line, the POERBCS zoning map and the 2008 coastal protocol.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The families listed in the viability question would be consulted at that point. [pause]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal’s Visión pillar opens with a clear risk statement for tourism in Baja California Sur.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It flags the Los Cabos tourism-residential engine and the coastal corridor as the core of the current path.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That setup concentrates demand on water, grid and coastal ceilings, according to the same pillar.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: 2025 occupancy reached 70.0 percent in Los Cabos, per SETUE.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz sat at 64 percent for the same period.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Hotel Association then reported 78 percent occupancy in Los Cabos for the first half of November 2026.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: At state scale the read stays constrained because the Cabos engine and Pacific corridor pull air and tourism demand onto DMA deficits and an isolated SIBCS under alert.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto sit in conservation-growth tension while Comondú keeps relative agri headroom.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The north stays thinly documented, though a remote generation tender is now underway.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The portal’s Tendencia 2050 says Baja California Sur does not hold together as one coastal formula repeated from south to north.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Instead it points to a polycentric system with distinct roles for each zone.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos stays the tourism engine but under water and power stress, while La Paz becomes the service capital and water-energy node.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto functions as a tourism-conservation anchor and Comondú as an agricultural hub with more room.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The aspiration in the Visión pillar is tourism that fits within water, energy and coastal ceilings without cloning the Cabos model statewide.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Occupancy and spending figures serve as signals, not as volume targets for 2050.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The levers listed are concrete.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Condition new growth on evidenced water and power margin or a non-DMA source that does not pretend NOM-011 credit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Treat beach closures and coastal quality as a limit on the vocation, not a seasonal incident.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Shift relative weight toward La Paz, Loreto and the interior, each with its own role.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The conditions repeat that each vocation must contribute distinctly and that East Cape and Loreto must respect ANP and POEL ceilings before scaling hospitality.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Comondú and the north can add production or energy without emptying services or protected areas.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: On the watchlist sits Punta Lobos and Hotel San Cristóbal, with a technical finding on causes and a Profepa review of the environmental authorisation and debris handling.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal’s demand-supply board summarises the state-scale picture as constrained, yet the polycentric reading still stands.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What remains uncertain is how quickly the distinct roles can be locked in before the next round of coastal pressure builds.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about the water margin test applied to every new project.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly. Without that evidence the ceilings become real limits rather than abstract goals.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The takeaway this week starts with what IMCO presented at the Mar de Cortés Forum.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They recorded BCS moving up several places in state competitiveness over recent years.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That improvement matters for tourism because it shows the state can attract visitors while building stronger foundations.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Mm. Really? How does that connect to the bigger picture?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Occupancy and spending figures are treated only as signals, not as volume targets.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: State officials would carry the main responsibility for keeping projects inside those ceilings.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: [chuckle] What remains unknown is exactly how those ceilings will be measured and enforced across different municipalities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Reports also note several hotels and ferry operators adjusting operations to match changing conditions.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Baja Ferries wants to turn Sea of Cortez crossings into a holiday experience while staying inside the same limits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep wondering how local communities will be included when those rules are written.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: [pause] So do I.
